label: Acts attests a Christian community at Derbe

date.note: Paul's first missionary journey per the Pauline chronology Acts presupposes; Acts itself was composed c. 80–90, a generation later (hence the retrospective grade).

secondary.cite: Harnack, Mission and Expansion, vol. 2, pp. 185–186

notes: Derbe's site was long disputed and is fixed to Kerti Höyük on the basis of an inscription found in 1956. Pleiades also carries an approximate record (648621); this uses the located one (648620).
